hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$({ pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check; } 2>&1) || { echo 'Lint/format/type check failed:' >&2; echo "$out" | tail -30 >&2; exit 2; }
